issues.detail: The Hebrew 'בִּקְהַ֖ל יְהוָֽה' means 'in the assembly of Yahweh' (i.e., in the congregation/assembly of the LORD), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'trong vòng họ của Đức Giê-hô-va' which means 'in the circle of their family of the LORD' or 'in the circle of their clan of the LORD'. The word 'họ' (family/clan) is an addition not present in the Hebrew; the Hebrew has 'qahal' (assembly/congregation), not 'family' or 'clan'. This changes the meaning from being excluded from the assembly of the LORD to being excluded from a family circle, which is a substantive difference.
